text:
ana_sales: Quick heads-up — Verdant (Sam) wants to run a short POC with their finetuned-llama40b-qd variant. Key asks: 1) confirm catalog compatibility + quantization path, 2) KMS + data residency, 3) estimate POC pricing for 3 weeks @ medium concurrency.

sam_verdant: Hi! Yes — small user-facing assistant, ~4k context, expect peaks ~40 rps, avg 15 rps. We can tolerate 200-400ms avg gen latency. Need to validate output quality on our prompt set.

leo_se: Thanks. I'll run a compatibility probe. Quick q: is this model using custom ops? Any dynamic layers? If not we can try q8_0 and q4_0 candidates.

sam_verdant: No custom CUDA kernels. It's finetuned on Llama40b, export is HF .bin and sharded. No special ops.

raj_sec: Security checklist: they require BYOK (KMS) for key material and audit logs. Also need SOC2/Pen test attestation. We can support KMS + audit, but need to confirm on-prem deployment for data residency. @mira_infra can you confirm private deployment options?

mira_infra: We can offer Private (VPC) in us-west-2 or on-prem appliance. BYOK via customer KMS is supported in Private; hosted requires CC encryption + our KMS (we can discuss bring-your-own-key for Dedicated later).

leo_se: Running a quick validation plan: 1) small tokenized dry-run on hosted catalog CPU path to check tokenizer/seq lengths, 2) test inference with 1 GPU (int8) to evaluate correctness, 3) run KV cache sanity and prefix caching on a few prompt batches.

ana_sales: Client is price-sensitive. Can you ballpark POC cost for 3 weeks if hosted with dedicated 1x A100 equiv? They will do ~1M tokens/day during peaks.

leo_se: Roughly: Dedicated reserved 1x A100 equiv + ops = ~$12k/week, so ~36k for 3 weeks. If we do hosted burst with autoscaling maybe ~$18k-$24k depending on actual token deltas. I will get exact from pricing team.

toni_sales: Also note discounts for trials — we can offer a POC credit of up to $8k on approved deals. I'll coordinate terms.

raj_sec: Also send them our standard security questionnaire. Sam — please fill section on data categories and retention. Attach link: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qa (placeholder).

sam_verdant: Got it. I'll fill sections today. Also: do you support quantized checkpoints (4-bit) for lower cost during POC?

leo_se: Yes — we support q8_0 and LLAMA-optimized q4k variants. Caveat: q4 reduces output quality slightly; we'll run side-by-side evals with your prompt set. Recommend toggling candidate models via rollout A/B in Console.

mira_infra: For performance, enable prefix caching + adaptive batching; for your workload we'll recommend batch_target=16 and max_latency_slo=0.35s after initial runs.

leo_se: Next steps: (1) Sam to share a 50-prompt eval set + sample model artifact link, (2) Raj to send sec questionnaire, (3) Mira to confirm Private deployment lead time (est 3-4 weeks), (4) Ana/Toni finalize POC commercial terms. I'll kick off a compatibility job today and post results here.

ana_sales: Thanks team! Sam — I'll set up a quick 30-min call Friday to align.

sam_verdant: Friday works. Appreciate the quick turnaround 🙏

leo_se: Kicked off probe job — job-id `probe-1745555555-1`.

mira_infra: Private lead time noted: 3-4 weeks for onboarding + KMS integration. If they want faster, we can do hosted POC with data isolation + NDA.

leo_se: Probe results (prelim): tokenizer OK, shards load, int8 run succeeded, q4 run has minor logits drift on some prompts — will quantify. Posting artifacts in shared drive: https://drive.example.com/rd/verdant-poc

sam_verdant: Nice — can you add a sample diff report for top-3 prompts? that's most important.

leo_se: Will attach after deeper eval. tagging @ana_sales @toni_sales

ana_sales: Good progress. I'll wait for the diff before pricing commit. :thumbsup:
